name: hasMobileIncidentEscalationCapability
definition: True when the vendor's own escalation configuration shows at least one escalation group that pages at least one subscribed member by a mobile method (SMS, MMS, phone, voice or push), not email alone.
population: the escalation groups the connected managed-detection tenant lists
evidenceRequiredForTrue: At least one escalation group whose delivery methods include a mobile method and that has at least one subscriber (proof even on a partial read), or a complete read of at least one group none of which does (False): a mobile method on a group with no subscribers pages nobody. A method is mobile by whole-word match (sms, mms, phone, voice, push) or a known whole value (text_message, phone_call, mobile_push, with or without the underscore); a method that names email is never mobile. No group, an error or refused answer, a partial read with no such group, or a mobile method only on groups whose subscriptions are not in the body is not measured.
